role: local evidence producer and diagnostic envelope renderer

obligations.action: Render the exact cause-bound recommended and avoid actions; never convert candidate signals into advice.
obligations.scope: Bind request, operation, dataset, provider, and source identifiers to the envelope subject; reject cross-operation evidence.
obligations.timing: Record assessed_at, observed_age_seconds, validity, and remaining validity; reject expired evidence.
obligations.redaction: Emit typed summaries and stable opaque refs only; never emit keys, headers, URLs, bodies, rows, or user identity.
obligations.unknown_fallback: When corroboration is absent or specific causes conflict, emit unknown/gather_more_evidence.
